Technical

Stats

GOB_GoblinSapper
Goblin Sappers are generic  Goblin characters.

Involvement

They only appear during the ⁠Raid on the Emerald Grove. They carry explosives and seek to blow themselves up upon the Overgrown Portcullis to the grove.  Rozzak introduces them to  Minthara under the name of pariahs. If killed, they detonate dealing 4d4+18⁠⁠Force in their vicinity.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Dash ()

Cover more distance this turn: double your Movement Speed.

 Range: Self
 Detonate ()
Damage: 44~68
8d4 + 36⁠Force

Blow up the powder keg on your back, damaging all nearby creatures and objects.

Doesn't affect creatures that have total cover from you.
